parsed.degree_signal: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience required
parsed.notes:
Section 'Experience in one or more of the following is helpful:' treated as nice_to_have heading.
'Machine learning research or engineering' mapped to both machine-learning and ml-engineering (flagged ml-engineering as uncertain since it shares the 'Machine learning' prefix).
'modern AI systems, tools, or research' not mapped to ai-ml or ai-developer-tooling as the phrasing is general rather than a specific taxonomy alias.
'software design, debugging, and problem-solving skills' not mapped to software-architecture or testing as neither 'software design' nor standalone 'debugging' are taxonomy aliases.
'orchestration' in 'Distributed systems, model serving, orchestration, or high-throughput research infrastructure' not mapped to llm-orchestration or containerization as it refers to general compute/system orchestration in context.
